definitions.gloss: pressure pattern; arrangement of pressure systems
definitions.explanation: The arrangement of high- and low-pressure areas across a region, as shown on a weather map. It determines wind direction and overall weather conditions.

examples.japanese: {冬型|ふゆがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気圧|きあつ}{配置|はいち}になった。
examples.english: A winter-type pressure pattern has set in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気図|てんきず}→天気図：20288_tenkizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気圧|きあつ}{配置|はいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I check the pressure pattern on the weather map.

examples.japanese: {西高東低|せいこうとうてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気圧|きあつ}{配置|はいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{北風|きたかぜ}→北風：21247_kitakaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
examples.english: A high-west, low-east pressure pattern continued, bringing strong northerly winds.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{気圧|きあつ}→気圧：00219_kiatsu⟧ (atmospheric pressure) + ⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧ (arrangement, layout). A weather-forecast term for how high- and low-pressure systems are positioned.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冬型|ふゆがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気圧|きあつ}{配置|はいち}: winter-type pressure pattern
- {気圧|きあつ}{配置|はいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}む→緩む：10056_yurumu⟧: the pressure pattern weakens

USAGE:
A frequent phrase in TV and newspaper forecasts. {西高東低|せいこうとうてい} (high pressure to the west, low to the east) is the classic winter pattern that brings cold northerly winds to Japan.
